However, for devices with Make-in-India (MI I) component of more than 40%, the price ceiling sh all be Rs. 1,30, 000/- + taxes. This price ceiling is inclusive of cost of standard soft ware. The Standard Soft ware: Any software (Operating System, Antivirus software or MS-Office etc.) that is essential for the runnin g of device towards discharge of official functions/duties. Hence, bidder s are advised to quote the price ac cordingly. 2.
